archive.catalogue_description: Hello how are you? I hope that very good. After a while without maps, I decided to bring you this map. I know it’s something simple worse is better than nothing after so long of not having uploaded maps. I clarify that I am very grateful to the people who helped me with this map since they were working on the wonder weapon that makes it work as it should against zombies. Anyway, I hope you enjoy it, it’s a simple map like I said and I’m not going to say much here. just come in and enjoy. Create two modes so that no one says that the map costs them a lot or that it is difficult. you choose which one to play. and well…. later I’ll see if I bring more maps. Also thanks to creep115 for lending me a map prefab of it and allowing me to change it my way. THIS MOD NEED T4M!! What does the mod include? BO1 WEAPONS ZOMBIES WITH MODELS FROM FIVE NIGHT AT FREDDYS PURCHASABLE END SPECIAL WEAPON MADE FOR THOSE ZOMBIES JUST AND NECESSARY XD. THE ZOMBIES IN THEIR NORMAL MODE RUN AND IN THE EASY MODE THEY ARE NORMAL. THANK YOU ALL FOR PLAYING THE MAP GREETINGS Credits: Shipudden1592 Thunderfrost Creep115 Taxi Luis1234 Mr White Gympie5 Ugx Mods

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
